Definition: of Hebrew origin (H1463); Gog, a symbolic name for some future Antichrist:--Gog.
BiblicalUsage: In the New Testament, Gṓg is the word for Gog. In Revelation 20:8, the text says "Gog and Magog."
TheologicalSignificance: I read gṓg plainly — it means Gog, and I do not build a doctrine on it.
